rules_tested: R21: Unclean TCP_DROP without Logout triggers 2 * HeartBtInt (60000ms) SenderCompID lockout (status=LOCKED_OUT)
R22: Premature RECONNECT_ATTEMPT during lockout window is rejected without advancing sequence numbers
R23: Post-lockout RECONNECT_ATTEMPT with ResetSeqNumFlag=Y (141=Y) resets NextSenderMsgSeqNum and NextTargetMsgSeqNum to 1
R24: Inbound Logon (35=A, 34=1, 141=Y) transitions session back to ACTIVE and clears disconnect_time_ms
R5: Subsequent outbound NewOrderSingle (35=D) transmits at MsgSeqNum=2
expert_rationale: Unclean TCP_DROP at t=100000ms locks out SenderCompID for 2 * 30000ms = 60000ms (until 160000ms). Reconnect at t=125000ms is ignored. Reconnect at t=161000ms with reset_seq_num_flag=True resets both sequences to 1 and emits Logon (34=1, 141=Y), followed by NewOrderSingle at 34=2.
